reason: I'd tap through to the certificate first, and if the certifier is one I and the WhatsApp group actually trust, I'd risk £4.95 on the trial pack. I wouldn't commit to a full pouch or a subscription until I'd seen it work and heard someone I follow vouch for it.
objection: Which certifier is it, really? Some UK bodies accept stunned meat and some don't, and with bovine collagen that matters to me. A logo on a pouch isn't enough until I know the name and their standards for the slaughter.
would_change_my_mind: If the certifier turned out to be one that allows stunning, or one nobody in my circle recognises, I'd stop at the trial or not buy at all. A creator I follow showing real results over a couple of months would get me onto the subscription.
